title: Agent Engineer
description:
About the Role
This role sits at the intersection of agent systems, platform engineering, integrations, and product development at an early-stage AI productivity startup building an autonomous executive assistant. You will help define what the assistant can do, how those capabilities work, and how they become dependable production experiences that users can trust with real work. It is a high-ownership position with direct influence on technical direction and product outcomes.
What You'll Do

• Investigate advances in reasoning, planning, memory, tool use, and agent collaboration to identify valuable product opportunities.

• Translate promising model behaviors into reliable, reusable skills and workflows that solve real user problems.

• Build and evolve a custom Python agent harness, including execution loops, orchestration, context management, structured outputs, retries, and error recovery.

• Design agent tools and integrations across email, calendars, messaging platforms, browsers, documents, CRMs, and other business software.

• Own capabilities end-to-end across the Python agent, Django services, React interfaces, data models, background jobs, observability, and production operations.

• Build platform abstractions that make capabilities easier to compose, extend, and maintain as the product grows more sophisticated.

• Improve latency, cost, reliability, and safety across high-volume agent execution.

• Partner with an Agent Evaluations team to define expected behavior, instrument capabilities, and turn quality findings into engineering improvements.

• Study production traces and user feedback to understand where trust breaks down, then fix the underlying system.

• Set technical direction on ambiguous problems and raise the engineering standard through design reviews and thoughtful execution.

What We're Looking For

• 5 or more years building production software systems end-to-end, including design, implementation, deployment, and operational iteration.

• Strong Python proficiency with the ability to write maintainable production code, debug asynchronous systems, and design sound abstractions.

• Hands-on experience building agent systems: planning, tool calling, structured outputs, context management, state management, retries, and orchestration.

• Full-stack flexibility with deep Python and Django expertise plus comfort working with APIs, React, and TypeScript.

• Experience designing and building integrations with external APIs and business software platforms such as email, calendars, messaging, and CRMs.

• Ability to translate emerging technical capabilities and vague user needs into concrete, simple product features without requiring complete specifications.

• Experience designing reusable platform abstractions and systems that enable composition, extension, and maintenance at scale.

• Analytical debugging ability spanning prompts, traces, model outputs, application code, databases, and user interactions.

• Familiarity with agent frameworks or orchestration platforms such as LangChain or AutoGen is a plus.

• Experience optimizing for latency, cost, and reliability in high-volume distributed systems is a plus.

• Background in autonomous systems, robotics, or workflow automation is a plus.

Location
Hybrid, based in Palo Alto, California. Visa sponsorship is not available.

title: Curation & Funding Coordinator
description:
Job Vision
Trust is the funding and development arm of the larger family of brands. Trust exists to provide filmmakers with capital and resources to bring their visions to life. Through direct film funding to commissioning work that generates revenue to buyouts of previous work to secure capital for a future project, Trust works with filmmakers in many ways to allow them to create on their own terms. Trust then takes that footage and licenses it to generate its own revenue which allows us to fund more projects. This role includes management of the contract editors who shape and curate footage, sourcing and buying pre-made assets, and maintaining the administrative work that this work requires. You'll report and collaborate closely with the Director of Trust to learn and grow the business but primarily invest your time and effort in editor direction, curation, and buyout pipeline.
What You’ll Do
Editor management and footage curation

• Manage a roster of contract editors, including finding new editors, assigning work, setting curation standards, reviewing output, and giving clear feedback

• Own curation quality across footage: what makes the cut, how it's organized, and how it's prepped for the library

• Keep editors unblocked and on schedule, balancing efficiency with quality

• Maintain and refine curation guidelines as the catalog and Trust's needs evolve

Asset buyouts

• Source pre-made assets that fit Trust's library strategy and gaps

• Evaluate assets for quality, rights, fit, and ROI before purchase

• Negotiate and execute buyouts, tracking spend against budget

• Maintain clean records of what was bought, from whom, and under what terms

• Help analyze and evaluate buyout process to ensure that each opportunity is fair and valuable

Administrative

• Own the paperwork and tracking tied to editor contracts and asset purchases (agreements, invoices, payment coordination, rights documentation, talent and property releases)

• Own the management of footage as it moves through the pipeline (footage review, tagging, featuring stand out footage, and operating within Trust’s footage management platform)

• Keep acquisition and curation data accurate and current in our systems

• Report on pipeline status, spend, and throughput to Director of Trust

• Coordinate across Trust and the wider FM org as needed

Requirements
What We’re Looking For

• Experience managing contractors or freelancers, ideally editors or creative talent

• A strong eye for footage quality and a sense for what makes a library valuable - understanding what’s trending in advertising

• Comfort with buyout/licensing negotiating and the rights questions that come with them

• Organized and detail-driven

• Self-directed and able to own a workflow end-to-end

• Clear, direct communicator

Nice To Have

• Background in commercial producing, post-production, or media licensing

• Familiarity with digital asset managers and project management platforms like ClickUp

• Experience tracking budgets or spend

• Experience negotiating deals for projects

What Success Looks Like

• Library curation stays top tier, with footage selected, organized, and prepped to a consistently high standard

• Contract editors operate with clear direction, accountability, and strong, on-time output

• Asset buyouts are well-sourced, fairly priced, and aligned to library strategy and gaps

• Buyout spend stays on budget and delivers strong value per dollar

• Rights, contracts, and acquisition records remain clean, accurate, and audit-ready

• Curation standards stay current as the catalog and Trust's needs evolve

• The curation and buyout pipeline aligns smoothly with commissioned and funded production work

• Workflows align effectively with broader FM systems, processes, and priorities

• Architecture & Collaboration: Ability to translate complex algorithmic requirements (such as business logic or data science models) into extensible platform components that support multiple teams.

• Modern Development Tooling: Comfort using modern development tools and LLM assistance to accelerate implementation while maintaining architectural oversight and code quality.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

You will lead a team of Mission Engineers who serve as Axon’s embedded builders and operational partners inside strategic public safety agencies. Mission Engineers work face-to-face with the people doing the work, diagnose how the agency operates, and build the workflows, automations, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions that measurably improve it.

As Senior Manager, you will create the environment in which that work succeeds. You will coach experienced individual contributors, set a clear bar for technical delivery and agency partnership, and help the team turn ambiguous field problems into secure, maintainable solutions that reach production and earn sustained adoption. You will stay close enough to the portfolio to recognize patterns, anticipate risk, and connect what the team learns in the field back to Product, Engineering, and the broader organization.

Success is reflected in agencies becoming more capable, Mission Engineers growing into trusted transformation leaders, and strong field solutions becoming reusable patterns that benefit customers beyond a single engagement. Axon’s mission is to Protect Life, and this team is one of the most direct ways we advance that mission alongside the agencies we serve.

What You’ll Do

Location: Southeast US Regionally based with Travel up to 40%
Reports to: Senior Director, Customer Deployment & Mission Engineering
Direct Reports:   Individual Contributors

Lead, Coach, and Develop Mission Engineers

• Lead and develop a distributed team of embedded Mission Engineers working across strategic agency environments

• Coach individual contributors through complex technical decisions, ambiguous customer problems, executive conversations, and high-stakes delivery moments

• Establish clear expectations for ownership, technical quality, onsite partnership, production delivery, adoption, documentation, and measurable agency impact

• Build individualized development plans and create opportunities for Mission Engineers to expand their technical range, executive presence, and transformation leadership

• Foster a culture of curiosity, candor, responsible experimentation, continuous learning, and shared accountability

• Support thoughtful team growth by selecting and onboarding people who can both build practical solutions and earn credibility with agency stakeholders

Set the Bar for Agency Outcomes

• Ensure Mission Engineers begin with the agency’s mission, operational workflow, and desired outcome before selecting or building a solution

• Require clear baselines, success criteria, and adoption measures so impact is demonstrated rather than assumed

• Guide the team from discovery through production use, iteration, handoff, and sustained adoption

• Help Mission Engineers balance immediate agency needs with secure, maintainable, and scalable solution design

• Reinforce that success means the agency is more capable-not that one individual has become indispensable

Own a Strategic Mission Engineering Portfolio

• Maintain visibility across strategic agencies, active builds, adoption progress, technical risk, and emerging operational needs

• Match Mission Engineer capability and level to agency complexity, transformation opportunity, and stakeholder environment

• Use operating reviews and portfolio data to identify delivery risks, recurring friction, adoption barriers, and opportunities for reuse

title: Engagement Coordinator
description:

Reports to: Director of Coaching Excellence
Location: Fully remote, working US Eastern Time hours
Pay: $24,000 a year to start, rising with each year of service
About this Role
Engagement Coordinators are the EMERSE equivalent of paralegals in a law firm. They are the operational backbone of client delivery: engagements run smoothly, coaches are fully supported, and clients get a seamless experience. The role combines project management, client administration and sales support, and it builds deep knowledge of EMERSE's products and services.
This role suits someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented and always looking to improve how things work. Coordinators handle logistics and administration, and they also support clients directly: answering questions, running NPS surveys and keeping the CRM current. Over time, a Coordinator becomes a near-substitute for a coach on operational matters, which makes the role an indispensable part of how EMERSE delivers.
About EMERSE
EMERSE is a global sales transformation agency headquartered in Miami, USA, and London, UK. We help growth-oriented companies build diagnostic, scalable systems that make sales growth fast, predictable and profitable.
We specialize in sales diagnostics, playbooks, coaching, bootcamps, hiring systems and ongoing execution support . We help businesses codify and implement repeatable sales systems while developing their people into elite performers.
Our purpose is simple and ambitious: to bring excellence to the profession of sales, change lives for the better, and free business owners from the frustrations of growing revenue. Our team shares a commitment to discipline, clarity and impact, and we are redefining what sales excellence means in practice.
Culture and Values
We exist to bring excellence to the profession of sales . We help companies hit ambitious targets, grow profitably and improve lives. Our mission is to restore sales as a serious, service-led profession, rooted in integrity, clarity and impact.
Our Values
Our culture is built on five values that guide how we work, collaborate and grow:

• Make an Impact: Take action, own outcomes, and deliver meaningful results.

• Think Around Corners: Anticipate challenges, plan ahead, and act with agility.

• Speak to Hearts & Minds: Communicate authentically, inspire action, and build trust.

• Raise the Bar: Be bold, set high standards, and continually strive for excellence.

• Be a Good Human: Act with integrity, keep your word, and do what's right.

Our Beliefs

• Sales, when done from a place of service, is a noble profession.

• We have a duty to help clients buy, even if that means not from us.

• We aim to be the obvious destination for growth-minded companies who share our values.

The Role
The Engagement Coordinator makes sure coaches and clients are fully supported through every engagement. You'll keep visibility over all the clients assigned to you, keep the CRM accurate, prepare contracts and sales decks, track renewals, client spend and NPS results, and make sure every client journey is documented and improved.
You'll be expected to know EMERSE's products and services as well as the coaches do, and to step in and answer client questions where appropriate. The role goes beyond administration into solving problems before they land, improving how we work, and freeing coaches to focus on high-value client delivery.
What You'll Do

• Keep Membrain, our CRM, current with each client's journey, renewals, spend and NPS scores.

• Coordinate each client from onboarding through renewal as their trusted point of contact, and monitor client health.

• Run NPS surveys and track client satisfaction.

• Track program results and produce reporting that drives decisions.

• Prepare and edit sales decks, proposals and contracts for the coaches.

• Prepare engagements with the coaches: Miro boards, playbooks, OMG evaluations and programs.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As Finance Director for Fury, you'll own the financial strategy, planning, and execution for a program that spans R&D, flight test, production ramp, and fielded operations - often simultaneously. You'll be a true partner to the program managers, engineering leads, and Autonomous Airpower's leadership team, translating technical and schedule realities into financial plans that enable speed rather than slow it down. Recruit, develop, and lead a growing team of program finance analysts and cost estimators as the program scales.

The Autonomous Airpower business line, within Anduril’s Air Dominance & Strike division, is building the unmanned fighter jet Fury. The Fury product and related programs sit at the intersection of rapid hardware development, cutting-edge autonomy, and a production ramp that in many ways looks more like a tech product launch than a traditional defense acquisition. title: Senior Product Owner
description:

This role sits within the Engineering organization, reporting directly to the Director of Software Engineering, and carries ownership across two interconnected domains: Billing, which manages five distinct billing platforms, and Data, which owns ingestion and transformation pipelines built on GCP and BigQuery.

As a Senior PO at NMI, you are the subject matter expert for every feature your team builds. You do not hand off context to others - you carry it. You are present in the details: writing sharp user stories, validating acceptance criteria, conducting UAT, and ensuring releases meet the bar. You are the go-to person for your engineering team, your product manager, and your stakeholders when questions arise about how the platforms work, what is in flight, and what is coming next.

The seniority of this role comes through in the depth of your platform knowledge, your ability to navigate complexity across two technical domains simultaneously, and your capacity to influence decisions at the architecture and cross-team level - while never losing sight of day-to-day delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Agile Execution

• Collaborate with peer Product Owners to manage cross-team dependencies and sequencing across shared initiatives.

• Partner with Product Managers to deeply understand product strategy and vision, ensuring tactical execution is consistently aligned with business direction and stakeholder priorities.

• Provide product training and enablement for customer-facing teams, support, and other internal stakeholders.

• Maintain transparency by communicating upcoming work, progress, and timelines to stakeholders and executives.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for billing-related feature questions across engineering, finance, and operations stakeholders.

• Translate complex billing requirements from cross-functional stakeholders into well-defined, executable user stories.

• Identify and flag platform-level risks, technical debt, and consolidation opportunities in partnership with engineering leadership.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

As a software engineer in Wayve’s Core Simulation team, you will help develop the simulation system used to evaluate and improve Wayve’s driving intelligence. Wayve’s end-to-end driving stack creates unique simulation challenges: rather than testing independently specified modules, we need to reproduce the behaviour of a learned driving system across a complex combination of sensor data, model inference, routing, control and vehicle dynamics. Our simulator must be realistic enough to provide meaningful signal, reproducible enough for teams to trust the results, and descriptive enough to understand differences between simulated and on-road behaviour. Our open-loop and closed-loop simulation workflows share a common codebase, with different components executed and configured depending on the use case. You will initially work with the team focused on high-scale open-loop evaluation, while contributing to shared components and infrastructure used across the broader simulation system.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Work hands-on in the shared modern C++ and Python simulation codebase.

- Implement scoped features and integrate driving-stack components, simulated robot systems and new vehicle-platform capabilities.

- Support and test different simulation configurations, initially with a strong focus on high-scale open-loop evaluation.

- Investigate differences between on-road and simulated execution, tracing issues across component interfaces, data flows, timing and configuration.

- Improve automated testing, observability, reproducibility, reliability and developer tooling.

- Profile simulator workloads and contribute performance and scalability improvements.

- Collaborate with Simulation, Robotics, Autonomy, Evaluation, Platform and Data teams to clarify requirements and resolve integration issues.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Develop and maintain production-quality components within Wayve’s simulation system using modern C++ and Python.

- Integrate driving-stack components, simulated robot systems and new vehicle-platform capabilities into the shared simulation environment.

- Support different simulation configurations and ensure components interact correctly across applicable workflows.

- Investigate differences between on-road and simulated execution, identifying issues across data, inference and simulated components.

- Improve simulation reproducibility, reliability and debuggability through automated testing, observability and better developer tooling.

- Profile and improve simulator performance, helping us run increasingly large evaluation workloads efficiently.

- Work with internal users and adjacent engineering teams to clarify requirements, resolve integration issues and deliver scoped improvements.

- Contribute to technical designs and help evolve the quality and maintainability of the simulation codebase.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- Professional experience developing, delivering and maintaining production software in a collaborative engineering environment.

- Strong software development skills in C++ and Python, with depth in at least one and the ability to work effectively in both.

- Relevant experience in simulation, robotics, autonomous systems or similarly complex systems involving multiple interacting software components.

- Good understanding of software and data-oriented design, including how to build code that is maintainable, reusable and extensible.

- Experience debugging complex systems and reasoning about interfaces, data flows, timing and failure modes.

- Understanding of common software performance issues and the ability to make pragma

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

- Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

- Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

- Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

- Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities.

- Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

- Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

- Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

title: Operations Lead
description:
About Fin

Fin is a next-generation payments platform built for high-value, global, and instant transactions. We are a Series A-stage company backed by Sequoia, Circle, and other notable investors. Powered by stablecoins, Fin enables users and businesses to move millions of dollars in seconds - whether to other Fin users, directly into bank accounts, or across crypto rails. By combining the speed of crypto with the reliability and trust of traditional finance, Fin reimagines how money moves worldwide. If banks and payment products were reinvented today, they would look like Fin.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Fin is building financial infrastructure for businesses moving money globally. We’re a small team, which means some of the most important problems we encounter don’t fit neatly into product, operations, growth, or engineering.

We’re looking for someone who likes those problems.

You’ll take on important projects that need an owner, figure out what actually needs to happen, and drive them from an ambiguous problem to a working solution. Sometimes that means building a new internal process. Sometimes it means working directly with customers or partners. Sometimes it means digging into data, writing requirements, building lightweight tooling, or working with engineering to turn an operational problem into a product.

The problems will change as Fin grows. We want someone who is excited by that.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own high-priority projects that cut across product, operations, customers, and our external partners.

- Take loosely defined problems, determine what needs to be done, and drive them through execution.

- Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand problems and translate them into clear requirements.

- Build new processes and operating systems where none exist today.

- Identify recurring operational problems that should be solved through better tooling, automation, or product.

- Write requirements and work closely with engineering to build internal and customer-facing tools.

- Use data to understand how processes are working, identify bottlenecks, and determine where we should invest.

- Build lightweight tools and automations yourself when that is faster than building something into the core product.

- Help launch new products, partners, workflows, and markets by owning the operational pieces required to make them work.

- Jump into areas of the business that need additional ownership and leave them more scalable than you found them.

Your initial projects could include improving the systems behind customer onboarding and CDD, building better internal tooling, automating manual workflows, helping us launch new financial partners or markets, or owning operational pieces of new product initiatives.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You’re a strong generalist who is unusually good at getting things done.

- You’re comfortable starting with an ambiguous problem rather than a detailed set of instructions.

- You’ve owned projects across multiple functions and can keep a lot of moving pieces organized.

- You can understand a stakeholder’s problem, turn it into a concrete plan, and coordinate the people necessary to deliver it.

- You naturally think about systems. When you encounter a repetitive process, your instinct is to ask why it works that way and whether there’s a better solution.

- You’re comfortable working directly with customers and external partners.

- You’re analytically minded and comfortable using data to make decisions.

- You have enough technical fluency to work closely with engineers and understand technical products. SQL, APIs, automation tools, or experience building lightweight internal tools are all useful.

- You’re equally comfortable writing a requirements document, digging into a broken workflow, coordinating a complicated project, or doing the manual work necessary to understand a problem firsthand.

- You learn quickly and don’t need previous experience in every problem you’re asked

title: Product Lead (Travel Heavy)
description:
ABOUT COLUMN

For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand - builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.

At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Product Lead at Column, you’ll help lay the foundation for the company’s next decade of growth. There's no existing roadmap to inherit, no legacy backlog, no "how we've always done it." You’ll own some of Column’s most important products and initiatives, with a heavy focus on designing the systems and tools that directly shape our ability to scale. You’ll act as the “GM” of your product area, owning everything from product strategy and requirements to internal platform development, while working alongside senior leadership at Column to take our business to the next level.

This position will be based in our San Francisco office in the Presidio, with regular travel throughout the United Sates. You can expect to be on the road 50%+ of the time, often embedded on-site for 2-4 weeks at a time.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the product strategy, roadmap and outcomes for key products

- Find the biggest bottlenecks to scale, then design and ship the products and workflows that remove them

- Drive decisions around “build vs. buy” strategies for new tooling and systems we need to drive automation and scale

- Spend time on-site with operators to understand workflows firsthand and turn what you learn into product decisions

- Own execution end to end, driving timelines, alignment and accountability on execution across the team

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

- 5+ years of experience, including experience in product management at a high-growth technology company

- An understanding of what great software and exceptional user experiences look like

- A track record of shipping products that solved real operational or customer problems

- A business owner’s mindset. You’re as comfortable with pricing, margins, and P&L tradeoffs as you are with specs and roadmaps

- The ability to influence and align stakeholders with different priorities around a shared goal.

- A hyper-organized approach to execution. You’re comfortable running several workstreams across teams at once.

- Excitement about spending ~50% of your time on the road, embedded with the people and operations your products serve.

- A scrappy, roll-up-your-sleeves attitude. We thrive because we work harder, are more creative, and have zero ego when it comes to getting our hands dirty to build a business.

- Familiarity with banking or fintech is preferred but not required. An interest in becoming an expert in this space is a must.

 

WHAT YOU'LL GET FROM US

- 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!

- 🐣 Comprehensive family planning and fertility benefits via partnership with Carrot, including reimbursement of up to $20,000 in qualified expenses

- 🏡 Up to $2,000 (post-tax) monthly rent subsidy for employees living within 2 miles of Column’s office

- 💳 FSA and HSA account options to enable us

The automotive markets Holman serves include fleet management and leasing; vehicle fabrication and upfitting; component manufacturing and productivity solutions; powertrain distribution and logistics services; commercial and personal insurance and risk management; and retail automotive sales as one of the largest privately owned dealership groups in the United States.
Holman is looking for a Security Engineer to work where cloud infrastructure and software development meet. You will review and design security architecture for our cloud environments, maintain our application security tooling, and work directly with development teams to threat model applications and find and fix vulnerabilities. You will also perform third-party vendor security reviews, support our work with external penetration testing partners, help secure our growing use of AI, and take part in incident response as part of the broader security team.

Security Engineering

• Administer and maintain application and cloud security tooling, including cloud security posture, runtime application security, and API security testing platforms. This covers configuration, tuning, integrations, and keeping findings accurate.

• Help integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.

• Work with third-party penetration testing providers to support scoping, ongoing attack surface assessment, results triage, and remediation tracking.

• Report vulnerability exposure, remediation status, and risk to application owners and management.
Incident Response & General

• Participate in incident response activities, contributing cloud and application security expertise to investigation, containment, and remediation.

• Lead specific initiatives or workstreams when delegated.

• Share knowledge with peers and developers on secure design and coding practices.

• Stay current on cloud and application threats, attack techniques, and security technologies, and recommend improvements to Holman 's security posture.

• Perform other duties

The Hyperscale Line of Business builds and ships products to hyperscale customers at exabyte scale, with an emphasis on speed, reliability, and operational excellence. The Build Environments and Tools team owns developer productivity infrastructure related to build orchestration, build systems, and containerized build environments that engineers rely on daily to build and test software.

• Experience with large-scale C/C++ builds, including dependency pruning, static/dynamic linking tradeoffs, and reproducible containerized builds

• Experience with CI pipelines and integrating build tooling into continuous integration workflows

• Experience using engineering metrics to evaluate and improve build performance, reliability, and developer experience

title: (Senior) Director UX, Operations
description:
About the role

HelloFresh is reorganising UX to work AI-native - practitioners either go deep as platform and skills experts, or broad as generalists who move fluidly across product, design and engineering to drive experience quality and innovation. This role leads UX for our Operations organisation: the part of the business that bridges technology with physical fulfilment, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain, across every market and brand we operate in.

You'll take over from a Director who spent two years shifting this function from reactive delivery to a high-leverage, AI-native strategic partner - including building an internal design platform, integrated with AI tooling, that other parts of the business have since adopted. You inherit that trajectory, not a finished product: some of our highest-stakes bets for 2026, including how we plan menus algorithmically at scale and how we run the internal tools that power supply-chain decision-making, are still being actively designed, not maintained.

This is a Berlin-based, in-person leadership role. Operations is one of several major, Berlin-anchored parts of our technology organization, and regular physical presence - with peers, with your team, and in the room for cross-functional decisions - is a deliberate requirement of how we want this function led going forward.

What you'll own

• UX strategy and quality across four core areas of Operations: menu planning and food systems (algorithmic menu planning, ranking, demand forecasting, assortment), fulfillment (production, order management, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, supplier reliability), an internal operations-research platform that runs dozens of optimization models across the supply chain, and the technology backbone that keeps our warehouses and production sites running.

You’re a problem solver at heart. You thrive at the intersection of engineering, computer science, and data, you’re motivated by questions that don’t have obvious answers, and you love to architect and build reliable systems that enable whole organizations to build world class analytics. You bring a background in engineering, computer science, physics, applied math, or another hard science discipline, and you enjoy applying that technical foundation to real-world data challenges.

•
3+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering.

• Ability to work independently and execute in a dynamic environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with geospatial data (e.g., spatial joins, geometry processing, or geospatial libraries).

• Experience with ML or MLOps pipelines.

• Knowledge of Snowflake streams, tasks, and performance tuning.

• Experience with large-scale or semi-structured datasets.

•
Relentlessly curious - you ask “why?” repeatedly until you reach the root

Collaborative - you enjoy working with engineers, data teams, and product stakeholders to deliver real customer value

title: Associate Director, Transaction Monitoring
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Airwallex is strengthening its global second-line Transaction Monitoring capability across products, payment rails and jurisdictions. You'll set the governance, challenge and modernisation agenda for a high-volume, global financial crime environment.

- Own Airwallex’s global second-line Transaction Monitoring strategy, governance framework and policy standards across products, payment rails, customer base and jurisdictions.

- Drive independent 2LOD challenge and oversight of 1LOD Transaction Monitoring teams, raising investigative rigour, alert disposition quality and consistency in suspicious activity detection.

- Oversee second line regional SAR/STR/SMR reporting teams in performance of L3 review and preparation of suspicious activity reports according to relevant requirements, in coordination with regional and local MLROs.

- Oversee the second line global Financial Intelligence Unit in performance of complex investigations, including cross-regional reviews, internal and external referrals, intelligence scanning and emerging risk typology development.

- Collaborate with the FCC Global Models lead on performance of appropriate governance of the global Transaction Monitoring rule lifecycle, covering typology identification, scenario logic, segmentation, threshold tuning, and above- and below-the-line testing across cross-border payments and multi-currency accounts.

- Lead the evolution from threshold-based monitoring towards AI-driven anomaly detection, machine-learning behavioural clustering and automated alert triage while maintaining explainability and regulatory defensibility.

- Partner with Product, Data Science and Engineering to embed Transaction Monitoring logic into core transaction-processing systems and real-time payment infrastructure.

- Resolve complex financial crime escalations, including novel laundering schemes, sanctions-evasion typologies and complex Suspicious Activity Report (SAR / STR) decisions.

- Improve model effectiveness by partnering with Model Risk Management, Quantitative teams and Audit to validate Transaction Monitoring models and maintain coverage mapping against global regulatory standards.

- Represent Airwallex’s Transaction Monitoring programme in regulatory examinations, including FCA, MAS, HKMA and AUSTRAC reviews, as well as partner-bank due diligence.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

ESSENTIALS

- 10+ years of dedicated AML and financial crime experience, with deep technical and operational expertise in Transaction Monitoring across global cross-border payments, corporate banking, FX or fintech platforms.

- 3+ years of experience leading, managing or mentoring compliance professionals in a global or multi-regional setting.

- Proven experience establishing 2LOD oversight frameworks, rule-governance processes and effective challenge mechanisms for high-volume, automated Transaction Monitoring platforms.

- Demonstrated ability to work with large data

title: Working Student (f/m/d) HR Strategy & Operations
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Join our team HR Strategy and Operations and actively drive our HR modernization forward! Having successfully concluded the initial roll-out phase of our initiative, we are now entering an advanced phase. Tasks

We value diversity and welcome all applications - regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

title: Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor - Industrial
description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking a Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor to join our team and support construction cost management services for clients delivering complex industrial projects. This role will be responsible for providing estimating, cost planning, cost reporting, change management, and commercial support throughout the project lifecycle.
The ideal candidate will have experience supporting industrial construction projects such as manufacturing facilities, processing plants, logistics and distribution centers, warehouses, advanced manufacturing facilities, life sciences facilities, food and beverage facilities, or other large-scale industrial developments. The successful candidate will be driven, collaborative, client-focused, and committed to promoting Turner & Townsend's purpose and values.

Responsibilities:

• Advising client on strategies, managing prequalification of vendors, assessing proposals, bids, and bid levelling documents, making final recommendations to the client, attending & chairing bid interviews, and managing appointment process.

• Manage estimating services for full project by developing project estimates (relating to construction, fees, direct work and other costs), reviewing estimations prepared by junior team members, presenting estimates to client, presenting value engineering recommendations and risk assessments to client, meeting with vendors to review, validate, and challenge costs, and reviewing estimates by utilizing benchmark data collected from other projects.

• Manage cost reporting by establishing reporting schedule, reviewing & presenting cost reports and forecasts, reviewing project budget & spend forecast with the client, developing & maintaining commercial risk register, and hosting periodic meetings with project team & vendors.

• Manage cost control process by reviewing payment application assessments prepared by junior team members, liaising with project managers to recommend contractor entitlements, reviewing requests for change orders from vendors & making recommendations to client, and using dispute prevention/management/resolution procedures to manage payment requisitions, change orders, and contractual disputes.

• Manage & monitor invoicing process.

• Benchmark performance against other successful commissions.

• Manage all facets of the final accounting process and post contract audits and account close outs.

• Hold post-contract reviews with the client to establish a lesson learned document and apply lessons to create training manual.

• Develop procedures governing handover of project.

• Perform all the duties above through the use/preparation of Bid Analysis Sheets, Change Control Forms, Cost Estimating Software, and Take-off Software.

• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.

• Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience working in a cost management role in the construction industry.

• RICS accredited or working towards it is valuable

• Experience supporting cost management on medium or large sized construction projects.

• Construction consultancy experience is strongly preferred.

• Good knowledge of construction industry technical matters, such as different procurement routes, value management, and value engineering.

• Strong communication skills.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: MA Licensed DBT Therapist for Adolescents - DBT Master’s or Doctoral - Telehealth - Full-Time
description:
About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role:
Lyra developed an innovative video therapy program called Lyra Care Therapy: Blending live video sessions with between-session digital psychoeducation and customizable skill building tools. The Lyra Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) program capitalizes on Lyra Care Therapy to supplement standard individual DBT and DBT skills groups with novel between-session DBT-relevant digital activities-activities that help promote skill generalization and integration into your clients’ daily lives. Lyra DBT clients also have 24/7 access to a team of licensed clinicians who have been trained in DBT skills coaching for around the clock support.
